items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I'll never forget one guy that I was really impressed by... Johnny Bothwell. He had a band for a while.

ctx.x: And I still kept my ears tuned to the radio quite a bit, and listened to the records on the jukebox, and I had my choice of people I liked, and I went ahead with people that, you know, I was impressed by.

I'll never forget one guy that I was really impressed by. He was out of the Johnny Hodges mode. And I never hear anybody talk about this guy, but he was a great saxophone player. I hate to put emphasis on what color, but he was a White saxophone player -- and there hadn't been many of them broken the mold from the Wayne King type of thing with the heavy vibrato and all that. And he was a beautiful saxophone player, Johnny Bothwell. He had a band for a while.
